purpose: Candidate routes for building structures after the D4 sample is either accepted or rejected under strict criteria.

target.spectrum: single upward narrow transmission peak, T<=1, clean near-zero background, no unexplained oscillation
target.source_band_policy: choose band from estimated mode wavelength, not fixed to 0.9-1.7 um

blueprints.lesson: Good for learning coupling optimization, but any Abs(T)^2>1 is non-accepted. Needs strict T<=1 and resonator-plane field explanation.

blueprints.why_for_target: A stopband mirror naturally suppresses background, while a defect creates a single upward passband peak.
expected_failure_modes: defect too lossy or too weak

blueprints.why_for_target: Periodic slab mode can create a sharp resonance; symmetry and grating strength tune linewidth.
expected_failure_modes: Fano dip instead of upward peak

blueprints.why_for_target: A broad bright mode plus narrow dark mode can create a narrow transmission window; coupling strength tunes width and peak.
initial_formulas: dark-mode leakage controlled by symmetry breaking
